settings.heading: Referral Program
settings.subtext: Love your land? Share Ty-Leigh Capital and earn rewards.

settings.intro: When someone you refer buys a property, we'll send you a referral reward as a thank-you for spreading the word. It's our way of showing appreciation for your trust — it's that simple.

settings.heading: Step 1 — Refer a Friend
settings.text: Tell a friend or family member about Ty-Leigh Capital and the affordable, owner-financed land we offer.

settings.heading: Step 2 — They Purchase
settings.text: When your referral buys a property from us, just have them mention your name at the time of purchase.

settings.heading: Step 3 — Earn Your Reward
settings.text: We'll send you a referral reward as a thank-you for spreading the word about Ty-Leigh Capital.

settings.heading: Ready to Refer Someone?
settings.subtext: Call or text us at (662) 442-4362 to learn more about current referral rewards and program details.
